_comment: BUG-617: what the internal-agreement check covered. Same strings as frontend/src/domain/agreementScope.ts (a frontend test compares them). Coverage only: no count of agreeing pairs.
heading: What this check compared
limit: Partly assessed: VERIDICAL cannot yet reliably tell which statements report this study's own results, so this check does not change readiness.
absence: An objective with no matching result is not reported here.
not_identified: The results section could not be found, so possible results were taken from every part of the paper. Some of them may describe other studies.
older_no_scope: This report was made before VERIDICAL recorded what this check compared.

methodology: describes how the study was done
front_matter: does not report the study's own results
table_of_contents: does not report the study's own results
biography: does not report the study's own results
references: does not report the study's own results
appendix: does not report the study's own results
future_work: does not report the study's own results

matching_caveat: VERIDICAL matches each objective with the results most like it. Some matched pairs may not belong together, and this matching is being improved. A matched pair is not proof that both statements are about the same thing.
interrupted_tail: Pairs it did not compare are not treated as passed.
interrupted: The check was interrupted before it compared every pair.

objective_roles.methodology: describes how the study was done
objective_roles.conclusion: sums up what the study found

objective_other: does not state this study's own objectives
objective_set_aside_list_intro: These statements read like objectives but are in parts of the paper that usually do not state this study's own objectives. Open one to check it yourself.
objectives_kept_despite_role: Every possible objective was in a part of the paper that usually does not state this study's objectives, so all {n} were kept and compared anyway. Some may be other studies' aims or steps of the method.
objectives_not_identified: The chapter that states the objectives could not be found, so possible objectives were taken from every part of the paper. Some may be other studies' aims.
objectives_set_aside_unlisted: Where these were set aside from was not recorded, so they cannot be listed here.
